description: Port Constanta - Retea de transport terestru is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ANCPI. The data set includes the network of roads and railways within Constanta Port. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Port Constanta - Land transport network" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2020-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
